(the Company) (Nasdaq: FBLA), the holding company for Fidelity Bank, announced today it has completed its second stock repurchase program. Under the plan, the Company repurchased 1,785,375 shares of its common stock, or 10% of its then outstanding shares, at an average price of $13.717 per share, inclusive of trading costs and commissions.
